design: pre-specified 7 R13 large-sample endpoints x 9 UKB-PPP CX3CL1 pQTL instruments; all results reported, no selection

data_sources.exposure: Open Targets Platform v26.9, studyId UKB_PPP_EUR_CX3CL1_P78423_OID20976_v1 (9 SuSiE credible sets, 3 cis / 6 trans)
data_sources.endpoint_manifest: no public manifest for R13; case counts NOT used

honesty_boundaries: This is a pipeline/instrument validation and power benchmark, NOT an independent positive-control aetiological study.
The 6 trans instruments (ABO/FUT2 etc.) have documented horizontal pleiotropy (Open Targets precomputed coloc H4 up to 1.0); no significant result may be interpreted as a CX3CL1 causal effect.
All numbers come from real HTTP range downloads and execution; no simulation, no imputation, no fabricated values.
